ValidationRule.description: Ensures that the deal type and opportunity type are the same or do not create any conflicts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND( ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.Type , "New Deal"),OR( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, "New Service Line"), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, "Department Add"),ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, "Upsell"))), AND( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.Type , "Up-Sell/Lift"), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, "New Deal")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a deal type that corresponds with opportunity type.
